Part 1: Merge specimens from other museum datasets into Bulbul_AVONET_data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)

#My bulbul dataset
bulbuls <- read.csv("../data/Bulbul_AVONET_data.csv")
str(bulbuls)
#Florida Museum of Natural History (FLMNH) dataset
flmnh <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_oac.xlsx")
str(flmnh)
#UPLB Museum of Natural History (UPLB) dataset - Phillipines
uplb <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_uplb_philippines.xlsx")
str(uplb)
uplb$Bill_TotalCulmen <- as.numeric(uplb$Bill_TotalCulmen)
uplb$Bill_FromNostril <- as.numeric(uplb$Bill_FromNostril)
uplb$KD <- uplb$Wing_Chord - uplb$Sec1_Length
#Only keep row 34 and beyond
uplb <- uplb[34:nrow(uplb), ]
#SYSU Guangzhou dataset - China
sysu <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_SYSU_China.xlsx")
str(sysu)
#Steinhardt MNH - Israel
steinhardt <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_Steinhardt_NihanD_Israel.xlsx")
str(steinhardt)
steinhardt$Number <- as.character(steinhardt$Number)
steinhardt$Subspecies <- as.character(steinhardt$Subspecies)
#Field data 1: Wenyi Zhou's field data from China
field1 <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_Wenyi_Zhou_China.xlsx")
str(unique(field1$sp.latin))
# Remove duplicate columns if they exist
field1 <- field1[, !duplicated(colnames(field1))]
field1 <- field1 |>
  filter(sp.latin %in% c(
    "Pycnonotus sinensis",
    "Spizixos semitorques",
    "Hemixos castanonotus",
    "Ixos mcclellandii",
    "Hypsipetes leucocephalus"
  ))
str(field1)
field1$Country_WRI <- "China"
field1$Measurer <- "Wenyi Zhou"
field1$Source <- "Field1"
#Field data 2: Peter Mikula and Martin Hromada's field data from Angola
field2 <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Mikula-Hromada_Sample data sheet.xlsx")
str(field2)
field2 <- field2 |>
  filter(Family == "Pycnonotidae")
str(field2)
field2$Comments <- as.character(field2$Comments)
field2$Wing_Chord <- as.numeric(field2$Wing_Chord)
field2$Date.collected <- as.character(field2$Date.collected)
field2$Collection <- "Field1"
field2$Measurer[field2$Measurer == "Peter Mikula"] <- "PM"
field2$Measurer[field2$Measurer == "Martin Hromada"] <- "MH"
#LSUMNS bulbul data: David Vander Pluym
lsumns <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Bulbul_Vander_Pluym.xlsx")
str(lsumns)
lsumns$Measurer <- "DVP"
lsumns$KD <- lsumns$Wing_Chord - lsumns$Sec_1
lsumns$`Number/Code` <- as.character(lsumns$`Number/Code`)
#Museum data from Peter Mikula (measured by Martin Bulla) - National Museum, Prague, Czechia
nmpc <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Bulla&Mikula_bulbuls_NMP_export.xlsx")
str(nmpc)
nmpc$KD <- nmpc$Wing_Chord - nmpc$Sec_1
nmpc$Measurer <- "MB"
#Cambridge University Museum of Zoology (CUMZ) dataset - UK (part measured by Carla only, Elizabeth yet to be added)
cumzcarla <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample data sheet CJD.xlsx")
cumzelizabeth <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample data sheet EMS.xlsx")
cumz <- bind_rows(cumzcarla, cumzelizabeth)
str(cumz)
for (i in 1:nrow(cumz)) {
  if (cumz$Measurer[i] == "Carla du Toit") {
    cumz$Measurer[i] <- "CJD"
  } else if (cumz$Measurer[i] == "Elizabeth Steell") {
    cumz$Measurer[i] <- "EMS"
  }
}
cumz$Date.collected <- as.numeric(cumz$Date.collected)
#UMICH initial dataset - Probst
umich <- read.csv("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_UMICH_Probst.csv")
str(umich)
umich$KD <- umich$Wing.length - umich$First.secondary.length
umich$Measurer <- "CMP"
umich$Number.Code <- as.character(umich$Number.Code)
#NMNH dataset - Manila, Philippines
nmnh <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_NMNH_Philippines.xlsx")
str(nmnh)
nmnh$Bill_Width <- as.numeric(nmnh$Bill_Width)
nmnh$Bill_Depth <- as.numeric(nmnh$Bill_Depth)
nmnh$Tarsus_Length <- as.numeric(nmnh$Tarsus_Length)
nmnh$Subspecies <- as.character(nmnh$Subspecies)
nmnh$Comments <- as.character(nmnh$Comments)
#Universitas Andalas dataset - Indonesia
ua <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_UA_Muhammad.xlsx")
str(ua)
ua$Measurer <- "MNJ"
ua$Subspecies <- as.character(ua$Subspecies)
#Kansas University Natural History Museum (KUNHM) dataset - Camila Meneses and 1 more colleague
ku <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_KU_CamilaMendes.xlsx")
str(ku)
ku$Measurer[ku$Measurer == "Camila Meneses"] <- "CM"
ku$Measurer[ku$Measurer == "Kier Mitchel Pitogo"] <- "KMP"
#Royal Ontario Museum (ROM) dataset - Vedant Gattani
rom <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_ROM_VG.xlsx")
str(rom)
rom$KD <- rom$Wing_Chord - rom$Sec_1
rom$Date.collected <- as.numeric(rom$Date.collected)
rom$Measurer <- "VG"
#Taiwan Biodiversity Research Institute (TBRI) dataset - Taiwan
tbri <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_TBRI_Stephanie.xlsx")
str(tbri)
tbri$Measurer <- "SYC"
#David Vander Pluym's dataset 2
lsumns2 <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Bulbul_Vander_Pluym_part2.xlsx")
str(lsumns2)
lsumns2$Measurer <- "DVP"
lsumns2$KD <- lsumns2$Wing_Chord - lsumns2$Sec_1
lsumns2$`Number/Code` <- as.character(lsumns2$`Number/Code`)
lsumns2$Date.collected <- as.character(lsumns2$Date.collected)
#Kunming Institute of Zoology (KIZ) dataset - China (Liu Yang and Yue Wu)
kiz <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_KIZ_LiuYang.xlsx")
#Change sex column from 1 and 2 to M and F, and make it a character column
kiz$sex <- as.character(kiz$sex)
kiz$sex[kiz$sex == "1"] <- "M"
kiz$sex[kiz$sex == "2"] <- "F"
#Make Scientific_Name of Brachypodius melanocephalos to Microtarsus melanoleucos to match AVONET
kiz$Scientific_Name[kiz$Scientific_Name == "Brachypodius melanocephalos"] <- "Microtarsus melanoleucos"
str(kiz)
kiz$Measurer <- "YW"
#NMNZ - National Museum of New Zealand dataset - New Zealand (measured by Richard Littlauer)
nmnz <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_RL_NMNZ.xlsx")
str(nmnz)
#WFVZ dataset - Western Foundation of Vertebrate Zoology, USA (measured by René Corado and Hannah Batten)
wfvz <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_WFVZ.xlsx")
str(wfvz)
wfvz$Date.collected <- as.character(wfvz$Date.collected)
wfvz$Subspecies <- as.character(wfvz$Subspecies)
#Peter Mikula - Lubango Museum Angola dataset (half done)
lubango <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_Lubango_Mikula.xlsx")
str(lubango)
lubango$`Number/Code` <- as.character(lubango$`Number/Code`)
lubango$KD <- lubango$Wing_Chord - lubango$Sec_1
#Cornell University Museum of Vertebrates dataset - USA (measured by Vanya GR)
cornell <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_Cornell_VGR.xlsx")
str(cornell)
cornell$`Number/Code` <- as.character(cornell$`Number/Code`)
#Dhaka University Museum dataset - Bangladesh (measured by Md. Mizanur Rahman)
dhaka <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_Bangladesh_DU.xlsx")
str(dhaka)
dhaka$Date.collected <- as.character(dhaka$Date.collected)
dhaka$Subspecies <- as.character(dhaka$Subspecies)
dhaka$Comments <- as.character(dhaka$Comments)
#Malcolm Soh field dataset - Singapore (measured by Malcolm Soh)
singapore <- read.csv("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_MS_Singapore.csv")
str(singapore)
singapore$Age <- as.integer(singapore$Age)
#Naturalis Leiden first batch - Netherlands (measured by Michael Nicolai)
naturalis <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_Naturalis_MN.xlsx")
str(naturalis)
naturalis$Sex <- ifelse(naturalis$Sex == "?", "U", naturalis$Sex)
#Naturalis Leiden second batch - Netherlands (measured by Michael Nicolai)
naturalis2 <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_Naturalis_MN2.xlsx")
str(naturalis2)
naturalis2$Sex <- ifelse(naturalis2$Sex == "?", "U", naturalis2$Sex)
naturalis2$Subspecies <- as.character(naturalis2$Subspecies)
#IISER Tirupati banding dataset - India (measured by Naman Goyal mostly)
iiser <- read.csv("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_IISER_Naman.csv")
str(iiser)
#Average out Bill_TotalCulmen1, 2, and 3 into one Bill_TotalCulmen column
iiser$Bill_TotalCulmen <- rowMeans(iiser[, c("Bill_TotalCulmen1", "Bill_TotalCulmen2", "Bill_TotalCulmen3")], na.rm = TRUE)
iiser$Tarsus_Length <- rowMeans(iiser[, c("Tarsus_Length_Left1", "Tarsus_Length_Left2", "Tarsus_Length_Left3", "Tarsus_Length_Right1", "Tarsus_Length_Right2", "Tarsus_Length_Right3")], na.rm = TRUE)
iiser$Wing_Chord <- rowMeans(iiser[, c("Wing_Chord_Left", "Wing_Chord_Right")], na.rm = TRUE)
iiser$Sec_1 <- as.numeric(iiser$Sec_1)
iiser$`Kipp.s_Distance` <- as.numeric(iiser$`Kipp.s_Distance`)
iiser$Date.collected <- as.character(iiser$Date.collected)
#MVIC collections Melbourne (measured by Lainie Berry)
mvic <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_MVC_LB.xlsx")
str(mvic)
#Queensland Museum dataset - Australia (measured by Richard Fuller)
qum <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_QUM_RF.xlsx")
str(qum)
qum$Subspecies <- as.character(qum$Subspecies)
#Smithsonian dataset - USA (measured by Klara Widrig)
smithsonian <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_KW_Smithsonian.xlsx")
str(smithsonian)
#Smithsonian dataset 2 - USA (measured by Stephanie Chia)
smithsonian2 <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/Sample_data_sheet_SYC_Smithsonian.xlsx")
str(smithsonian2)
smithsonian2$Subspecies <- as.character(smithsonian2$Subspecies)
#Phil Round's Thailand banding dataset
phil <- read.xlsx("../data/Collaborator data/PR_Thailand/Sample_data_sheet_PR_Thailand.xlsx")
str(phil)
#Adding locality information for the Thailand dataset from Phil's Places.xls file, then add a column to the phil dataset with the locality information stored in PLNAME, matching using the PLACE column in philplaces and Locality column in phil
philplaces <- read_excel("../data/Collaborator data/PR_Thailand/Places.xls")
str(philplaces)
phil <- phil %>%
  left_join(philplaces, by = c("Locality" = "PLACE")) %>%
  rename(Locality_PLNAME = PLNAME)
str(phil)
#Removing all rows that have an RTYPE value of "R", an AGE value of 1, and at least 1 trait measurement that is not NA or missing out of the Bill_TotalCulmen, Wing_Chord, Tarsus_Length or Tail_Length columns
phil <- phil |>
  filter(!(RTYPE == "R" & AGE == 1 & ( !is.na(Bill_TotalCulmen) | !is.na(Wing.Chord) | !is.na(Tarsus_Length) | !is.na(Tail_Length) ) ))
phil$Country_WRI <- "Thailand"
#Remove phil$Locality
phil <- phil %>%
  select(-Locality)


####RENAME####
naturalis2 <- naturalis2 |>
  rename(
    AviList = Scientific_Name,
    Beak.Length_Culmen = Bill_TotalCulmen,
    Beak.Length_Nares = Bill_FromNostril,
    Beak.Width = Bill_Width,
    Beak.Depth = Bill_Depth,
    Gape_Width = Gape.Width,
    Tarsus.Length = Tarsus_Length,
    Kipps.Distance = `Kipp's_Distance`,
    Wing.Length = Wing_Chord,
    Tail.Length = Tail_Length,
    Country_WRI = Country,
    Specimen.number = `Number/Code`,
    Locality = Locality,
    Sex = Sex,
    Subspecies = Subspecies,
    Comments = Comments,
    Measurer = Measurer,
    Source = Collection
  )

phil <- phil |>
  rename(
    AviList = AviList,
    Tarsus.Length = Tarsus_Length,
    Wing.Length = Wing.Chord,
    Beak.Length_Culmen = Bill_TotalCulmen,
    Beak.Width = Bill.Width,
    Tail.Length = Tail_Length,
    Country_WRI = Country_WRI,
    Specimen.number = `Number/Code`,
    Sex = Sex,
    Measurer = Measurer,
    Date.collected = Date.collection,
    Locality = Locality_PLNAME,
    Mass = Mass
  )

traits <- c(
"Beak.Length_Culmen",
"Beak.Length_Nares",
"Beak.Width",
"Beak.Depth",
"Tarsus.Length",
"Wing.Length",
"Kipps.Distance",
"Tail.Length",
"Gape_Width"
)

#Removing all values that are outside 2 standard deviations from the mean for that trait for that species in the AVONET dataset, and replacing those values with NA, before merging with the new specimen data
for (trait in traits) {

  avonet_stats <- bulbuls |>
    group_by(AviList) |>
    summarise(
      trait_mean = mean(.data[[trait]], na.rm = TRUE),
      trait_sd   = sd(.data[[trait]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  phil <- phil |>
    left_join(avonet_stats, by = "AviList") |>
    mutate(
      !!trait := ifelse(
        !is.na(trait_sd) &
        abs(.data[[trait]] - trait_mean) > 2 * trait_sd,
        NA,
        .data[[trait]]
      )
    ) |>
    select(-trait_mean, -trait_sd)

}

#Merging step with AVONET data - do NOT remove any columns from the AVONET data frame, just add new rows for UMich specimens, and leave NA where information/columns are missing in UMich but present in AVONET
bulbuls <- read.csv("../data/Bulbul_AVONET_data_integrated.csv")
bulbuls2 <- bind_rows(
  bulbuls,
  phil %>% select(any_of(names(bulbuls)))
) %>%
  select(all_of(names(bulbuls)))
str(bulbuls2)
write.csv(bulbuls2, "../data/Bulbul_AVONET_data_integrated.csv", row.names = FALSE)
new_bulcount <- table(bulbuls2$AviList)
mean(new_bulcount)

#AVONET means for each trait, by species
avonet_means <- bulbuls |>
  group_by(AviList) |>
  summarise(
    across(all_of(traits), ~mean(.x, na.rm=TRUE)),
    .groups="drop"
  )
avonet_points <- merge(
  bulbuls,
  avonet_means,
  by="AviList",
  suffixes=c("_specimen","_mean")
)

#Museum means for each trait, by species
phil_means <- phil |>
  group_by(AviList) |>
  summarise(
    across(all_of(traits), ~mean(.x, na.rm=TRUE)),
    .groups="drop"
  )
phil_points <- merge(
  phil,
  avonet_means,
  by="AviList",
  suffixes=c("_specimen","_mean")
)



comparison <- merge(
  avonet_means,
  sysu_means,
  by="AviList",
  suffixes=c("_AVONET","_SYSU")
)

#Non-highlighted species mean plots
comparison_long <- comparison %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -AviList,
    names_to = c("Trait", "Dataset"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(AVONET|SYSU)",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Dataset,
    values_from = Value
  )

ggplot(comparison_long,
       aes(AVONET, SYSU)) +

  geom_point(size = 3, colour = "#009E73") +

  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~Trait, scales = "free") +

  theme_classic() +

  labs(
    x = "AVONET species mean",
    y = "SYSU species mean"
  )


#Method 2: Highlighting species with specimen measurements in the SYSU dataset, and comparing those to the AVONET means for those species
phil_species <- phil_points %>%
    filter(!is.na(Wing.Length_specimen)) %>%
    pull(AviList) %>%
    unique()

avonet_points_filtered <- avonet_points %>%
    dplyr::filter(AviList %in% phil_species)

avonet_long <- avonet_points_filtered %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_specimen"),
    names_to = "Trait",
    names_pattern = "(.*)_specimen",
    values_to = "specimen"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_mean"),
    names_to = "Trait_mean",
    names_pattern = "(.*)_mean",
    values_to = "mean"
  ) %>%
  filter(Trait == Trait_mean) %>%
  select(AviList, Trait, specimen, mean)

phil_long <- phil_points %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_specimen"),
    names_to = "Trait",
    names_pattern = "(.*)_specimen",
    values_to = "specimen"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_mean"),
    names_to = "Trait_mean",
    names_pattern = "(.*)_mean",
    values_to = "mean"
  ) %>%
  filter(Trait == Trait_mean) %>%
  select(AviList, Trait, specimen, mean)

ggplot() +

  geom_point(
    data = avonet_long,
    aes(mean, specimen, colour = AviList),
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = phil_long,
    aes(mean, specimen),
    colour = "#D55E00",
    shape = 17,
    alpha = 0.4,
    size = 1
  ) +

  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~Trait, scales = "free") +

  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +

  labs(
    x = "AVONET species mean",
    y = "Specimen measurement"
  )

ggsave("../results/Collaborator data comparisons/Phil comparison_Thailand.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)


#Checking for specimens that are > 3 standard deviations from the AVONET mean for that species, for any trait

avonet_stats <- bulbuls |>
  group_by(AviList) |>
  summarise(
    culmen_mean = mean(Beak.Length_Culmen, na.rm=TRUE),
    culmen_sd = sd(Beak.Length_Culmen, na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups="drop"
  )

florida_check <- merge(
  flmnh,
  avonet_stats,
  by="AviList"
)

florida_check$outlier <-
abs(florida_check$Beak.Length_Culmen - florida_check$culmen_mean) >
2*florida_check$culmen_sd
```
